thread:
Alex: :wave: Morning bridge note — I'm swapping coverage with @Jordan today. Quick highlights:
- Prefetch KV eviction spike overnight (small; self-healed)
- Canary for 3.2.1 rolled back due to memory regression
- Two PRs blocking a small deploy (see below)

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Canary alert fired at 03:12 UTC — memory > 85% on canary-3-2-1, auto-fallback executed. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/98321 :eyes:

Jordan: I'm taking the watch. I'll pick up the canary rollback follow-up and repro if needed.

Maria: Prefetch KV eviction root cause: a scheduled job had TTL set to 1h instead of 24h on one shard. I changed job-config-ttl -> 24h and restarted the worker; KPI looks back to baseline.

Sam: Blocking PRs: #4123 (batching refactor) needs a quick review — pinged @Kevin. #4130 (metrics tags) is green but waiting for a final CI flake check.

Kevin: Ack — I'll review #4123 shortly. Noted a failing assertion in batcher_test locally; will push a fix this afternoon.

Alex: Watchlist for the shift:
- p95 latency on /v1/generate in us-west-2 spiked to ~650ms between 09:00-10:00 PST (traffic burst). If p95 > 600ms persist for > 10min, please trigger fallback to redwood-lite-v1 per routing policy.
- Keep an eye on memory usage for canary-3-2-1 until we verify the rollback.

Priya: Quick helper command to tail runtime logs for eviction traces:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200 | grep -i evict
```Use that if you want recent eviction lines.

Jordan: Action plan for me:
1) Reproduce canary memory regression (if repro needed, spin a canary in eu-west1).
2) Merge metrics PR once Kevin approves.
3) Monitor us-west-2 latency for next 3 hours and escalate if p95 stays high.

Alex: FYI — staging infra maintenance scheduled tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC (brief pod restarts). Production is excluded.

Sam: Added note for support: please route any customer-visible regressions to #incidents immediately. Updated the handover doc with these items: https://redwood.internal/handovers/2026-03-18

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder — run the daily post-handoff checklist and mark the items done: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/daily-oncall-checklist

Kevin: pinged @Sam about that CI flake — if it flakes again, I'll rerun the job and merge if green.

Alex: Thanks everyone — leave any quick updates here and I'll check in at the 2h mark. :thumbsup:
